MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

3. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 46
   C. 120
   D. 23

5. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 22
   D. 88

7. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

8. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

11. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 24.5
   C. 7
   D. 49

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31

13. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

14. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

17. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

18. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 40.5
   C. 81
   D. 10

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

20. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

21. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

22. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 16
   C. 4
   D. 8

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 32
   C. 22
   D. 55

24. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 20
   C. 30
   D. 75

26. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 12

27. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

28. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

29. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 1

30. Solve for x: x + 3 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 12
   C. 3
   D. 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

33. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

34. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

36. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

37. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

38. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

39. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

40. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
